items.text: Commanders WR Stefon Diggs out due to hamstring; QB Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants. Terry McLaurin headed in good direction.
items.why: Hamstring injury; Daniels cleared/good to go after elbow.
items.implication: Daniels active elevates WAS passing attack; Diggs absence opens targets.
items.opportunity: Target/route share bump for Terry McLaurin and other WAS WRs/TEs.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) both ruled out for Week 5 vs Jaguars in London; Tank Bigsby also out/IR.
items.implication: Major PHI offense downgrade; pass-heavy script likely.
items.opportunity: Will Shipley leads RB room (bulk carries/routes); Dallas Goedert and remaining WRs elevated.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson ruled out for Sunday night vs Falcons with left ankle injury; Tyler Huntley will start.
items.why: Left ankle injury from Week 4; no practice all week.
items.implication: Huntley starts SNF; reduced dual-threat upside for Ravens skill players.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely, Derrick Henry in pass-heavy or committee scripts.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) ruled out for Sunday vs Browns; second straight miss.
items.why: Quadriceps; no practice this week, week-to-week.
items.implication: Braelon Allen handles lead back role again (near 100% prior week).
items.opportunity: Full RB opportunity for Jets committee lead; Garrett Wilson volume stable.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty listed as questionable on Friday injury report vs Patriots.
items.implication: Monitor for active/inactive; limited if plays.
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup RBs elevated in LV backfield.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift has no injury designation (hip/knee) for Sunday at GB; Kyle Monangai ruled out. Caleb Williams returned to practice (possible next week).
items.why: Swift cleared after missed practice time; Monangai out; Williams practiced.
items.implication: Swift full workload expected; Williams return window opens Week 6.
items.opportunity: Clear RB1 path for Swift; no Monangai competition.

items.text: Vikings listing both WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) as questionable for Sunday vs Saints.
items.why: Ankle for JJ; hamstring for Addison.
items.implication: Game-time decisions; if both limited/out, MIN WR depth and TE/RB targets rise.
items.opportunity: Potential boost to other MIN pass-catchers if either sits.

items.text: Levitan fears long-term sideways scenarios for Malik Nabers (knee issue becoming real, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching staff) despite great talent; good play this week but frustration over post-halftime targets noted.
items.why: Sore knee DNP earlier + stacked long-term risks (injury/QB/coaching); target frustration.
items.implication: Short-term startable but ROS caution; monitor knee/shoulder closely.
items.opportunity: If limited, other NYG WRs gain routes/targets.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; high volume including red zone vs soft Titans secondary.
items.why: Target hog + RZ usage + matchup gift.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 play; elevate in rankings.

items.text: ETR discusses Philly RB room post-Barkley/Bigsby: expects Will Shipley show vs Jacksonville with bulk opportunity.
items.why: Barkley/Bigsby injuries leave Shipley as primary; video analysis with Levitan/Silva.
items.implication: Shipley RB2/3 upside in vacuum; PHI more pass-oriented.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share for remaining PHI RBs; Goedert/WR targets up.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injuries context + soft run defense.
items.why: Heavy workload hard to ignore; MIA defense carved by RBs; CIN WR injuries may force more run.
items.conflict: Levitan notes underperforming xFP so far.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) for volume/matchups/coverage spots.
items.why: Target volume + RZ for Wilson; specific coverage weaknesses for Watson/Likely.

items.text: ETR/Thorman Week 5 snaps & pace: DET @ ARI up-tempo high-scoring potential; SF @ SEA projected slow slog. DET-ARI popular DFS stack due to total/pricing.
items.why: Projected combined plays/points; Lions elite environment, ARI matchup.
items.implication: Stack DET-ARI skill players; fade slow SF-SEA for volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route shares in high-pace game for DET/ARI stars.

items.text: Levitan notes Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs.
items.implication: Sustainable efficiency edge for Bijan/Kyren; regression watch or role issues for Jeanty/Brown.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown this week despite under xFP.
